package.name: cosmica_resources

description.p: Shared configuration data, 3D models, launch files materials, etc. for cosmica targets.
This package contains meshes for the cosmica targets, as well as any shared configuration data, launch files, materials, etc. for configuration of the facility.
Approach inspired by the fanuc_resources package. See https://github.com/ros-industrial/fanuc.

package.author: Alec Tiefenthal
package.maintainer: G.A. vd. Hoorn (TU Delft Robotics Institute)
